summary: Dedicated capacity expansion ETA slipping (pool not reaching Ready) during provisioning automation pilot
description:
Issue summary
- Customer (HelioFin) reports delayed readiness for a Dedicated capacity expansion in us-east.
- Expansion was scheduled under the new provision-to-ready automation pilot. Pool infrastructure provisioned successfully, but control plane did not mark added capacity as Ready within the communicated window.

Customer impact
- Customer planned to shift additional production traffic to the expanded pool by 2025-03-07 18:00 UTC.
- Current capacity is sufficient for baseline, but they cannot enable planned traffic increase; risk of missing an external launch milestone.
- Customer requesting: (1) updated ETA with confidence interval, (2) confirmation new nodes will not be advertised to routing until validated, (3) comms plan for future expansions.

Environment
- Dedicated (prod), region: us-east
- Expansion: +16 GPU nodes (SKU not shared in ticket; internal notes indicate H100 pool)
- Pool: hf-ded-us-east-02 (internal pool id: pool_9f3a…)

What we observed (internal)
- Provisioning run reached: Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping
- Bootstrapping completed, then Validating started; Ready did not transition.
- Readiness suite/perf-canary results were intermittently missing from the run record due to a race condition in the Ready gating path, causing the system to wait indefinitely for a completion marker.

Requested outcome
- Get the expansion to Ready and hand capacity to routing.
- Provide customer-facing timeline and a clear explanation (no sensitive internal details) and what we changed to prevent recurrence.

Initial mitigation
- Keep capacity out of routing until Ready is set.
- Offer customer an updated expansion window and, if needed, a partial handover once validation is complete (no earlier than Validating pass).
comments: 2025-03-06 09:12 UTC — Neha Kapoor (Support) — Ticket opened via email escalation from customer. Customer states: 'Expansion still not ready; we were told 6–8 hours. Please confirm whether this will be usable today and whether there’s any risk to existing traffic.'

2025-03-06 09:25 UTC — Neha Kapoor (Support) — Acknowledged to customer. Set expectation: update within 60 minutes with current stage + revised ETA; confirmed no capacity will be routed until marked Ready.

Customer-facing reply (sent):
- We’re actively investigating why the expansion has not transitioned to Ready.
- Existing traffic will not be impacted; new nodes will not receive traffic until validation completes.
- Next update by 10:30 UTC.
2025-03-06 09:41 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE) — Taking lead on technical triage. Pulling control plane run status + stage events. Looping in Fleet on-call (Harish) and provisioning eng (Vanessa/Gabe).

2025-03-06 10:05 UTC — Harish Reddy (Fleet Ops) — Checked provisioning logs for pool_9f3a…: Validating started ~08:52 UTC. GPU health checks passed. Networking checks passed. Perf-canary job launched but run record shows 'pending' despite benchmark job completion in perf-canary service logs.

2025-03-06 10:17 UTC — Rina Kobayashi (Perf-canary) — Confirmed readiness suite produced summary JSON for this run at 09:03 UTC, status=PASS (throughput within threshold). Suspect ingestion/handshake into control plane state transition.

2025-03-06 10:28 UTC — Ethan Park (Control Plane) — Found potential race: Ready transition can be evaluated before perf-canary completion event is persisted; if evaluated at wrong time, it never re-evaluates. This matches prior staging-only flake. Creating hotfix PR to make Ready gating transactional/retryable.

2025-03-06 10:33 UTC — Neha Kapoor (Support) — Customer update (sent):
- Expansion is fully provisioned and has passed core health checks; we’re waiting on final validation bookkeeping to complete before marking Ready.
- Revised ETA: 2–3 hours.
- We will not route traffic to the new nodes until Ready is set.
- Next update by 13:00 UTC.

2025-03-06 11:14 UTC — Vanessa Ortiz (Infra) — Confirmed this expansion is part of the pilot path (feature flag enabled). If hotfix is delayed, we can do a manual 'resume validation' step or re-run validation stage only (no re-provision). Prefer fix first to avoid repeated manual steps.

2025-03-06 12:02 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE) — Linked fix PR: redwood/pr-48245 (race condition causing Ready to be set before perf-canary completion; adds transactional check and ensures re-evaluation). Requesting expedited review. Also adding operator-facing error improvements in redwood/pr-48242 to prevent silent waits.

2025-03-06 12:48 UTC — Miles Thornton (SRE) — Reviewed blast radius: gating logic change is scoped to pilot feature flag path. OK to ship behind flag; ensure we can retry the Ready evaluation for in-flight runs.

2025-03-06 13:07 UTC — Ethan Park (Control Plane) — PR-48245 merged + deployed to us-east control plane (pilot flag only). Triggered re-evaluation for the in-flight run via admin endpoint; status moved to Ready after perf-canary PASS was attached to run record.

2025-03-06 13:15 UTC — Ravi Menon (Routing) — Verified routing integration only advertises pools marked Ready (redwood/pr-48234 already in place). New capacity now visible to routing; ramping via standard autoscaler policies. No anomalies in 5xx/latency so far.

2025-03-06 13:22 UTC — Neha Kapoor (Support) — Customer update (sent):
- Expansion is now Ready and can be used.
- We’ve validated hardware health + network readiness + a lightweight performance canary.
- We’ll monitor for the next 24 hours and will follow up with a brief summary of what caused the delay and what we changed.

Customer responded: 'Thanks — we’re proceeding with traffic shift. Please send the summary and updated expectations for future expansions.'
2025-03-07 09:10 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE) — Added monitoring note: keep alerting on stuck Validating > 45m for pilot pools; ensure dashboard variables populate for new pool IDs (INT-1045 in flight).

2025-03-08 16:40 UTC — Neha Kapoor (Support) — Sent final summary to customer:
- Delay cause: automation pilot had a control-plane bookkeeping edge case in the Ready gating step.
- Prevention: shipped a fix to make the Ready evaluation transactional and re-checkable; added better operator error messages; updated runbook.
- Safety: routing only consumes Ready capacity; capacity remained isolated until Ready.
- Commitment: for next expansion, we will provide stage-based ETA updates and a clear rollback/hold plan.
resolution:
Resolved 2025-03-06.

Resolution details
- Implemented and deployed fix for Ready gating race condition (redwood/pr-48245) behind the pilot flag; re-evaluated in-flight run and transitioned capacity to Ready.
- Confirmed routing only advertises Ready capacity and new nodes were not used until validation completed.
- Provided customer with revised ETA during incident, confirmed readiness completion, and shared follow-up summary.

Follow-ups
- Ensure stuck-stage alerting and dashboard drilldowns are fully wired for new pool IDs (INT-1045).
- Improve operator-facing errors and runbook references for validation waits (redwood/pr-48242 + runbook updates).
- Review pilot comms template for Dedicated expansions (Support/CS + Product alignment).
